title: CVE-2026-107951 — Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the
summary: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the CSP header. This potentially weakens the application's defense-in-depth security mechanism.
title_vi: CVE-2026-107951 — Cấu hình Chính sách bảo mật nội dung (CSP) không phù hợp trong BigFix MCM WebUI đã cho phép dữ liệu: lược đồ URI làm nguồn trong lệnh img-src của

title: CVE-2026-138117 — HyperSpy from 1
summary: HyperSpy from 1.2.0 before 2.6.0 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by embedding malicious expression strings evaluated with sympy.sympify(). Attackers can craft .hspy or .zspy files with malicious axis, Expression component, or twin function expressions that execute when victims call hs.load() or restore models.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138117 — HyperSpy từ 1

title: CVE-2026-138118 — HyperSpy from 1
summary: HyperSpy from 1.4.0 before 2.6.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by supplying crafted stored-model data in .hspy or .zspy files. Attackers can embed a malicious pickle payload in a component's _class_dump or a 'fn'-flagged _whitelist entry, which cloudpickle.loads() (dill in 1.x) runs when the victim restores the model.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138118 — HyperSpy từ 1

title: CVE-2026-138119 — Kestra before 1
summary: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting HTML into the executions page sort parameter. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted link whose invalid sort value is rendered unsanitized in an error toast, stealing the non-HttpOnly BASIC_AUTH credential cookie to take over the instance.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138119 — Kestra trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138120 — Kestra 1
summary: Kestra 1.3.24 before 2.0.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in BasicAuthService.isAuthenticated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate the administrator username. Attackers can send Basic-auth requests with candidate usernames to protected API endpoints and detect slower bcrypt checks to identify the valid account for password guessing.

title: CVE-2026-138121 — Kestra 1
summary: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a revoked administrator password to keep authenticating on peer webserver nodes through BasicAuthService's process-local verified-token cache. Attackers whose token remains cached on a peer node can call POST /api/v1/{tenant}/basicAuth to overwrite the shared administrator credentials and lock out the legitimate administrator.

title: CVE-2026-138122 — ClassroomIO through 1
summary: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying a foreign feedId under their own courseId. Attackers can read, react to, and comment on cross-organization posts, while team members or org admins can also overwrite content, pin flags, and delete them.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138122 — Lớp họcIO đến lớp 1

title: CVE-2026-138148 — picomatch through 4
summary: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators. Attackers who control file, object key or archive entry names containing newline characters can evade ** deny patterns, causing excluded resources to be included and exposed.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138148 — picomatch đến 4

title: CVE-2026-138149 — FeatBit before 6
summary: FeatBit before 6.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members of one organization to read other organizations' segments by supplying foreign segment identifiers. Attackers can query the SegmentController segment, by-ids, and flag-references endpoints with their own envId to retrieve end-user keys, targeting rules, and referencing feature flag keys.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138149 — FeatBit trước 6

title: CVE-2026-138150 — SimGear through 2024
summary: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero. Attackers can supply a crafted .btg scenery file with an oversized byte count exceeding 2^31 to hang the loading process in FlightGear.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138150 — SimGear đến năm 2024

title: CVE-2026-138151 — bgpq4 before 1
summary: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A<len> replies. Attackers controlling the IRR server or tampering with the plaintext TCP connection can announce a ULONG_MAX or -1 length, wrapping the allocation to one byte and crashing bgpq4.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138151 — bgpq4 trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138152 — Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3
summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the server contact arbitrary hosts via crafted Mailchimp API keys. Attackers can POST to the otter/v1/form/editor REST route with an apiKey whose data-center segment embeds a host, following redirects to internal services and reading partial responses.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138152 — Otter – Khối & tiện ích mở rộng trình tạo trang cho Gutenberg trước phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-138153 — Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3
summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that allows Contributor-level attackers to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can set the postTypes or queryPostType block attributes to types like flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon to expose titles and text, while the Atomic Wind custom_field path also leaks protected post meta.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138153 — Otter – Khối & tiện ích mở rộng trình tạo trang cho Gutenberg trước phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-138154 — POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCom
summary: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138154 — POSTAL 2 trước bản dựng 26810491 chứa lỗ hổng thoát sandbox cho phép các mod Steam Workshop độc hại thực thi mã bằng cách gọi ConsoleCom

title: CVE-2026-138158 — libgphoto2 through 2
summary: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory. When files are listed, the device can answer the file-name register with an oversized packet, writing up to 32 KB past small stack buffers to cause crashes or possible code execution.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138158 — libgphoto2 đến 2

title: CVE-2026-138159 — edbrowse through 3
summary: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB. When a user browses to an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the oversized body skips reallocation and corrupts the heap, causing crashes or potentially code execution.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138159 — duyệt qua 3

title: CVE-2026-138160 — Gammu before 1
summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138160 — Gammu trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138161 — Gammu before 1
summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file. Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138161 — Gammu trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138162 — Gammu before 1
summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook text. Attackers can supply a crafted backup restored with gammu restore or addnew to an attached Alcatel phone, using GSM extension characters to crash Gammu or potentially execute code.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138162 — Gammu trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138163 — Gammu before 1
summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138163 — Gammu trước 1

title: CVE-2026-138164 — Gammu before 1
summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text fields. Attackers can craft a backup with long calendar or note fields that, when converted with gammu convertbackup, writes hex digits past the 10,000-byte stack buffer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-138164 — Gammu trước 1

title: CVE-2026-120705 — OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
summary: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

extra.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

title: CVE-2026-129243 — OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
summary: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

summary: A vulnerability has been identified in Mendix Runtime V10 (All versions < V10.24.29), Mendix Runtime V11 (All versions < V11.17.0), Mendix Runtime V11.12 (All versions < V11.12.8), Mendix Runtime V11.6 (All versions < V11.6.13), Mendix Runtime V9 (All versions < V9.24.45). Affected versions of Mendix Runtime do not end existing sessions when a user account is set to inactive. The account state is checked at sign-in, but not on later requests made with a session that already exists. A user who is deactivated while signed in can keep using that session for as long as the client keeps it alive.

title: CVE-2026-137936 — Payload 3
summary: Payload 3.25.0 before 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.0 before 4.0.0-canary.34 contains an authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in its client upload handling, which used the upload collection supplied by the client instead of the one selected by the server. In deployments that use client uploads across multiple upload collections, an authenticated user with upload permissions can access files outside their authorized collection.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137936 — Tải trọng 3

title: CVE-2026-137937 — PDFio before 1
summary: PDFio before 1.6.5 contains an integer underflow in _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() in pdfio-aes.c, which strips PKCS#7 padding before any AES block has been decrypted when an AES-encrypted string or binary value holds only its 16-byte IV. Attackers can supply a crafted AES-encrypted PDF that, when opened with pdfioFileOpen(), makes the decrypted length underflow so that _pdfioValueDecrypt() reads and writes out of bounds, crashing the application or corrupting heap memory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137937 — PDFio trước 1

title: CVE-2026-137938 — Sparkle before 2
summary: Sparkle before 2.9.6 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the installer's SPUInstallationData handling in AppInstaller.m, which validates the symlink-resolved download URL but performs the privileged move on the unresolved URL and checks the file type only afterwards. A local user can swap an intermediate directory of the download path for a symlink between the check and the move, causing a root installer to rename a file out of a protected location and leading to privilege escalation when the installer runs in the system domain.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137938 — Lấp lánh trước 2

title: CVE-2026-137939 — Sparkle 2
summary: Sparkle 2.2.0 before 2.9.6 contains a link following vulnerability in -submitInstallerAtPath: in SUInstallerLauncher.m that builds a root updater's launcher cache path inside the console user's home directory and then deletes and creates items there without rejecting symbolic links. A local console user can pre-create that path as a symlink while a CLI tool or daemon updates a bundle as root, making root delete old files in a directory of the attacker's choosing and create a directory there that is chowned to the attacker, leading to privilege escalation.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137939 — Lấp lánh 2

title: CVE-2026-137940 — Pillow through 13
summary: Pillow through 13.1.0 contains an integer overflow in the ImageMath integer divide and modulo operators (DIV_I and MOD_I in src/_imagingmath.c), which guard only against a zero divisor, so dividing INT32_MIN by -1 raises a hardware divide exception. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF that decodes to a mode I image containing INT32_MIN, crashing applications that run an ImageMath divide or modulo with a -1 operand on it.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137940 — Gối xuyên qua 13

title: CVE-2026-137942 — Roundcube Webmail before 1
summary: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contains an authorization bypass in add_to_group() and remove_from_group() in program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_contacts.php, which did not verify that the contact group and the contacts belong to the current user. An authenticated user of the SQL address book can supply other users' group and contact identifiers to add contacts to or remove them from other users' contact groups, or to add other users' contacts to their own groups.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137942 — Webmail hình tròn trước 1

title: CVE-2026-137943 — Roundcube Webmail before 1
summary: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in compose_part_body() in program/actions/mail/compose.php, which converts a text/enriched message part to HTML for the HTML editor without sanitizing the result. Attackers can send a crafted email with a text/enriched part so that script injected into the HTML editor runs in the victim's session when the victim replies to, forwards, or edits the message.
title_vi: CVE-2026-137943 — Webmail hình tròn trước 1

title: CVE-2026-104928 — The system call verifier z_vrfy_k_thread_stack_space_get() in kernel/thread

title: CVE-2026-137951 — libexpat 2
summary: libexpat 2.6.0 through 2.11.0 built with XML_GE=0 and XML_UNICODE contains an out-of-bounds read in storeSelfEntityValue() because narrow string literals are treated as wide strings. Attackers can supply an XML document whose DOCTYPE declares a general entity to expose adjacent static memory through the entity value or crash the parser.

title: CVE-2026-137952 — svglib before 2
summary: svglib before 2.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in SvgRenderer.renderNode() that recursively renders internal <image> href fragment references without expansion limits or cycle detection. Attackers can supply crafted SVGs to svg2rlg() with nested groups referencing each other twice or self-referencing images to cause exponential resource consumption or RecursionError crashes.

title: CVE-2026-137953 — Pydantic Deep 0
summary: Pydantic Deep 0.2.18 before 0.4.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the bundled DeepResearch FastAPI app that exposes HTTP routes and the /ws/chat WebSocket. Remote attackers reaching the server bound to all interfaces can enumerate sessions, read event logs and workspace files, drive the research agent, and delete sessions.

title: CVE-2026-137954 — Pydantic Deep 0
summary: Pydantic Deep 0.2.18 before 0.4.0 contains a server-side request forgery and local file read vulnerability in the DeepResearch export_report handler for /export/pdf. Attackers can inject raw HTML into reports via the unauthenticated /upload endpoint, causing WeasyPrint to fetch internal URLs and embed local server files into exported PDFs.

title: CVE-2026-137955 — PlantUML through 1
summary: PlantUML through 1.2026.10, including PlantUML Server, contains a local file read vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass SANDBOX and INTERNET security profiles via Graphviz node attributes. Attackers can submit @startdot diagrams with image or shapefile attributes to render local image files into PNG output and probe whether arbitrary local paths exist.

title: CVE-2026-137956 — AVideo from 29
summary: AVideo from 29.1.0 before 29.8.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in plugin/YPTWallet/view/saveConfiguration.php that lets attackers modify a logged-in user's wallet configuration. Attackers can lure victims to a page auto-submitting a cross-origin POST with CryptoWallet and donation_notification_url to redirect payouts and capture donation notifications.

title: CVE-2026-137957 — n8n before 1
summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in integration nodes that build API request paths from unencoded record, table, or resource ID parameters. Attackers can supply relative path segments through untrusted input such as webhook bodies to read, modify, or delete unintended resources using the node's stored credential.

title: CVE-2026-137958 — n8n before 2
summary: n8n before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the AWS Bedrock Chat Model and Embeddings AWS Bedrock nodes, where requests to a custom Bedrock runtime endpoint set in an AWS credential bypass n8n's SSRF protection. An authenticated user who can create AWS credentials can point the endpoint at internal or blocked addresses, causing n8n to send requests there and exposing the start of responses in node errors.

title: CVE-2026-137959 — n8n before 1
summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.x before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 does not verify that the user activating a workflow can access the credentials set on its trigger nodes. An authenticated member who knows another user's credential ID can activate a workflow whose trigger uses it, causing n8n to create or delete webhooks on the connected service with that credential's privileges and deliver events from attacker-chosen resources to the member's workflow.

title: CVE-2026-137960 — Budibase backend-core before 3
summary: Budibase backend-core before 3.49.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated Builder/Creator users to bypass the outbound-fetch deny list by targeting the IPv6 unspecified address. Attackers can supply URLs with host [::] to features like Outgoing Webhook or REST datasources to reach IPv6 loopback services and read reflected internal responses.

title: CVE-2026-137961 — Budibase before 3
summary: Budibase before 3.51.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the workspace create handler that allows authenticated CREATOR users to probe server paths by supplying an unvalidated body.file.path value. Attackers can enumerate filesystem existence and type, and for directories containing db.txt, copy contents into their object store namespace before the directory is recursively deleted.

title: CVE-2026-137962 — Budibase server before 3
summary: Budibase server before 3.48.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public API view row search endpoint that skips per-view permission checks due to a tableId/viewId parameter mismatch. Authenticated users with READ_ONLY role and an API key can query restricted views to read data limited to higher-privileged roles.

title: CVE-2026-137963 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability where the Helm chart values.yaml sets secret_key_base and lockbox_key to a static published constant. Unauthenticated attackers can sign session tokens with the known key to impersonate any user and decrypt all stored datasource credentials.

title: CVE-2026-137964 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

title: CVE-2026-137965 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with the TEST_CONNECTION ability to reach arbitrary hosts by supplying body-controlled datasource options. Attackers can set kind, plugin_id, and host options for plugins like influxdb or elasticsearch to reach loopback, internal services, or cloud metadata endpoints exposing IAM credentials.

title: CVE-2026-137966 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an arbitrary file read and SSRF vulnerability in the SMTP plugin that allows authenticated app builders to pass object values to Nodemailer. Attackers can set textContent or htmlContent to path or href content objects to email server files or internal cloud metadata responses to themselves.

title: CVE-2026-137967 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server fetch internal URLs via the gRPC v2 proto_file_url option. Attackers can target loopback, private, cloud metadata, or redirect-controlled addresses, or serve oversized responses that are buffered and parsed synchronously, causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137968 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the OAuth token exchange for custom datasources, which sends requests to an unvalidated, user-configured access_token_url. Authenticated users can trigger the authorize_oauth2 endpoint to reach loopback, cloud metadata, or private network services, with internal response bodies reflected in some API error responses.

title: CVE-2026-137969 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery protection bypass because getSSRFProtectionOptions passes its safe resolver as dnsLookup instead of lookup. Attackers controlling datasource hostnames can use DNS rebinding in REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth requests to reach blocked private addresses.

title: CVE-2026-137970 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ssrf-protection.ts that fails to classify NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48) and 6to4 (2002::/16) IPv6 addresses embedding internal IPv4. Authenticated users can set REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth data-source URLs to attacker hostnames whose AAAA records resolve to these forms, bypassing pre-request and dial-time guards to reach cloud metadata and internal hosts.

title: CVE-2026-137971 — ToolJet before 3
summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the n8n, nocodb, baserow, couchdb, elasticsearch, influxdb, and databricks datasource plugins, which skip the validateUrlForSSRF check. Authenticated builders, or unauthenticated visitors of public apps with templated URLs, can supply internal URLs or hosts to read cloud metadata credentials and internal service responses.

title: CVE-2026-137972 — Heym before 0
summary: Heym before 0.0.154 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the workflow execute endpoint: anonymous workflows run as any signed-in caller, without an access check, using that caller's credentials and global variables. Authenticated attackers can lure signed-in users to a GET execute link for an attacker-owned anonymous workflow, which the SameSite=Lax session cookie authenticates. The attacker then reads the victim's decrypted credentials from the workflow's run history.

title: CVE-2026-137973 — Heym from 0
summary: Heym from 0.0.95 before 0.0.154 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to run script on the application origin by publishing HTML output mapper workflows. Attackers can set a workflow to anonymous GET and share the /api/workflows/{id}/execute link, causing visitors' browsers to send authenticated API requests to read or modify their workflows, credentials, and settings.

title: CVE-2026-137977 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::handle_write in libnetutil/massdns.cc that dereferences freed request objects after writes complete. Attackers controlling or on-path to a DNS server can send timed DNS responses with forged ICMP port-unreachable messages to crash scans, disclose memory, or hijack execution.

title: CVE-2026-137978 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::process_request in libnetutil/massdns.cc that frees still-referenced requests when rescheduling after DNS server disconnects. Attackers answering for at least two configured DNS servers can force a disconnect and send a precisely timed response to crash the scan, possibly enabling code execution.

title: CVE-2026-137979 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the Nmap Scripting Engine because nse_main.lua does not explicitly seed Lua's math.random generator. Malicious scanned hosts can observe math.random-derived values in NSE script traffic during -sC scans, brute-force the seed, and recover a heap address that weakens ASLR.

title: CVE-2026-137992 — libexpat through 2
summary: libexpat through 2.11.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in defineAttribute() of lib/xmlparse.c that fails to detect duplicate non-ID #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED attribute declarations. Attackers can supply a crafted XML document with repeated ATTLIST declarations in an internal DTD subset to cause quadratic CPU consumption in storeAtts() during parsing.

title: CVE-2026-137993 — django-allauth 65
summary: django-allauth 65.17.0 before 65.23.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in truncate_ip() that collapses all IPv4-mapped IPv6 clients into one shared rate-limit key. Unauthenticated attackers on dual-stack deployments can exhaust per-IP limits for login, signup or password reset, blocking legitimate IPv4 users.

title: CVE-2026-137994 — Leo through 6
summary: Leo through 6.8.10 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by embedding pickled data in unknown XML attributes of .leo outlines. Attackers can place a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a <t> or <v> element attribute that resolveUa passes to pickle.loads, executing code with user privileges when the outline is opened.

title: CVE-2026-137995 — FOG Project before 1
summary: FOG Project before 1.6.0.119 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain host tokens from status/hostgetkey.php by supplying a host MAC address. Attackers can present the token to service/hostinfo.php to retrieve decrypted Active Directory join credentials and Windows product keys during deployment windows.

title: CVE-2026-137996 — Zettlr before 4
summary: Zettlr before 4.11.0 fails to validate URI schemes in Markdown link targets, allowing attackers to launch arbitrary registered protocol handlers via Electron shell.openExternal without confirmation. Attackers can craft documents whose Ctrl/Cmd-clicked links use smb:// to leak NTLM credential hashes on Windows or invoke custom protocol handlers with attacker-controlled parameters.

title: CVE-2026-137997 — HCIPy through 0

Because hcipy/util/io.py selects pickle by file extension and calls pickle.load, a __reduce__ gadget in a pupil, apodizer, PSF or mode-basis file runs code with the user's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-137898 — A flaw was found in pam
summary: A flaw was found in pam. When built with libeconf and an unconfigured vendor directory, the pam_econf configuration handler misinterprets the search path, causing it to look for configuration files in a relative directory within the current working directory. A local attacker can exploit this by placing crafted environment configuration files in a world-writable location. If an administrator executes a privileged command from that directory, the malicious variables are loaded into the privileged process, resulting in local privilege escalation.

summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The ASCII-armor reader does not limit the length of a line. Parsing an armored message with a very long line can exhaust memory in the process. Memory use follows the input size, with a small constant factor, and is not a classic amplification.

title: CVE-2026-115836 — A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp
summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The default ASCII-armor parser accepts Unicode dash characters in armor framing and ignores leading quote characters. A crafted byte stream can be parsed as one message by this tolerant parser and as a different message by a strict ASCII-armor parser. The strict mode is opt-in; the default parser remains tolerant.

title: CVE-2026-115841 — A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp
summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. DSA signature verification does not reject a public key with generator 1 and public value 1 before calling the cryptographic backend. Upstream reports that the Nettle and OpenSSL backends, including the default Nettle build, accept this key. Under that key, a signature can verify for every message. Ordinary DSA keys are not affected. An application is exposed when that degenerate certificate is accepted as authoritative.

title: CVE-2026-132890 — In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1
summary: In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1.0.0-RC2 through 1.0.0-RC7, the HashiCorp Vault extension does not reject .. path segments in secret aliases. In a multi-participant (virtual) control plane where vault partitions share the runtime's Vault token, an authenticated participant can set a callback secret alias that escapes its own vault partition. The connector then reads secrets of other participants or of the runtime, such as STS client secrets or the encryption key, and sends them to an endpoint the attacker chooses.

title: CVE-2026-133842 — A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper
summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper. When a system-wide app, runtime, or extension uses the extra-data mechanism and its apply_extra logic creates a deeply nested directory tree, permission canonicalization can fail (for example with EMFILE). Affected Flatpak versions can still report success without clearing setuid/setgid bits, leaving a setuid-root executable under /var/lib/flatpak. A local attacker who can install or update such content system-wide, or who can already execute code as a local user in cooperation with that content, can escalate privileges to root.

title: CVE-2026-133845 — A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal
summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal. When a sandboxed application invokes Spawn() and maps two different file descriptors to the same handle, dup2() can fail. Affected Flatpak versions do not handle that failure, so a file descriptor that was open inside flatpak-portal (commonly the unfiltered D-Bus session bus) can be passed into the subsandbox. A malicious or compromised Flatpak app with no special privileges can use this to escape the sandbox.

title: CVE-2026-137609 — In Eclipse Krazo Extensions up to and including 3
summary: In Eclipse Krazo Extensions up to and including 3.0.0, AsciiDocViewEngine passes MVC model values to Asciidoctor as document attributes without encoding them. Asciidoctor substitutes attribute references after it escapes HTML special characters and before it processes inline macros. As a result, attacker-controlled model values end up in the output as raw HTML and can inject AsciiDoc inline macros. This allows cross-site scripting in applications that render untrusted data through AsciiDoc views.

title: CVE-2026-137686 — The fix for CVE-2014-0074 https://shiro

Alternatively, set principalSuffix on the realm, or disable anonymous binds

title: CVE-2026-137905 — FFmpeg 5
summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in parse_imf_asset_map_from_xml_dom() in libavformat/imfdec.c that does not check for a missing or empty Path element in an asset map Chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-137906 — FFmpeg 5
summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the IMF demuxer in libavformat/imfdec.c because open_virtual_track() accepts a virtual track with no resources. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF Composition Playlist whose virtual track lists no resources, causing set_context_streams_from_tracks() to dereference a NULL resource array and crash the process.

title: CVE-2026-137907 — FFmpeg 3
summary: FFmpeg 3.0 before 8.1.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_boxblur.c because query_formats() accepts pixel formats deeper than 16 bits while the blur temporary buffers hold only 2 bytes per pixel. Attackers can supply crafted 32-bit float media, such as PFM or OpenEXR images, that when processed by the boxblur filter overflow the temporary buffers, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

title: CVE-2026-137908 — FFmpeg 7
summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

title: CVE-2026-137909 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

title: CVE-2026-137910 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

title: CVE-2026-137911 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

title: CVE-2026-85561 — When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled be
summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled between DNSdist and one of its backends, an outgoing TCP connection could be wrongly reused for a query received over the same incoming DNS over HTTPS connection but with a different X-Forwarded-For header, causing the backend to consider the query as coming from the same remote client than the first query received on the outgoing connection.

title: CVE-2026-85562 — When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not rep
summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not replace existing X-Forwarded-For headers but merely append a new header to the query, the first header was used by DNSdist instead of the last one, making it possible for a client to spoof its own IP address.

title: CVE-2026-85563 — When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse p
summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DNS over HTTPS GET queries with a body. DNSdist should either refuse the query or ignore the HTTP body, but instead was processing the content of the HTTP body rather than the query present in the HTTP path.

title: CVE-2026-85565 — An attacker can trigger a synchronization issue on outgoing TCP connections between DNSdist and its backend by sending oversized DNS over HTTPS querie
summary: An attacker can trigger a synchronization issue on outgoing TCP connections between DNSdist and its backend by sending oversized DNS over HTTPS queries. This could cause the backend to refuse queries, send a server failure, or just close the TCP connection.

summary: An attacker might be able to forge its own source IP, smuggle DNS records or bypass EDNS options filtering via a specially crafted DNS query when EDNS Client Subnet is enabled between DNSdist and its backend.

title: CVE-2026-135899 — JobRouter Premium, version 2025
summary: JobRouter Premium, version 2025.1.11, has a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Favorites feature. An authenticated user with low privileges can inject JavaScript code that is persistently stored on the server. When other users access the affected page, the code executes in their browsers. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim, access sensitive information, or compromise the integrity of their sessions.

title: CVE-2026-137567 — llama
summary: llama.cpp b11450 before b12658 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ggml RPC server that allows unauthenticated attackers to write to arbitrary heap addresses via zero-element destination tensors. Attackers can learn buffer bases with BUFFER_GET_BASE, then send RPC_CMD_COPY_TENSOR with a destination pointer below the buffer base to crash the server or execute code.

title: CVE-2026-137568 — openFrameworks through 0
summary: openFrameworks through 0.12.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ofxAndroid OFZipUtil.extract helper that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory. Attackers can supply a crafted ZIP archive with entries like ../escaped.txt to write or overwrite files with the Android application's file permissions.

title: CVE-2026-137569 — Golift xtractr before 0
summary: Golift xtractr before 0.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction root because a strings.HasPrefix output directory check lacks separator awareness. Attackers can supply ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR, or other archives with entries like ../<outputdir>_evil/file to create or overwrite files in sibling directories.

title: CVE-2026-137570 — Open Policy Agent before 1
summary: Open Policy Agent before 1.20.0 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability that allows local users to overwrite files by abusing the fixed OCI store path used when persistence_directory is unset. Attackers can pre-create the opa/oci temp directory with index.json or oci-layout symlinks so OPA overwrites the target files with OCI JSON using its privileges.

title: CVE-2026-137571 — Iceburg CRM through 5
summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view server configuration through public/v.php calling phpinfo(). Attackers can request v.php directly, bypassing Laravel routing, to obtain PHP version, extensions, INI settings, DOCUMENT_ROOT, and environment variables.

title: CVE-2026-137572 — Iceburg CRM through 5
summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to modify workflows by calling the workflow save and delete endpoints. Attackers can send an empty workflow array to /data/workflow/save or call DELETE /data/workflow/{id} to wipe or rewrite the module conversion workflow.

title: CVE-2026-137573 — KodeRover Zadig before 5
summary: KodeRover Zadig before 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in aslan environment kube.go handlers that allows authenticated users to query Kubernetes clusters of other projects. Attackers can supply arbitrary clusterID and namespace values to /api/aslan/environment/kube/ routes to enumerate namespaces, nodes, deployments, workloads, canary mappings, and resource names.

title: CVE-2026-137574 — Iceburg CRM through 5
summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the related_fields and related_field_name routes in routes/data.php that lets authenticated users read restricted module data. Attackers can enumerate field_id values to query related module tables without Permission::checkPermission checks, reading id and name pairs such as user names from ice_users.

title: CVE-2026-137575 — Listmonk 4
summary: Listmonk 4.1.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CSV subscriber import that allows list-scoped users to overwrite subscribers outside their permitted lists. Attackers holding subscribers:import and list:manage on one list can import CSV rows with victims' emails and overwrite enabled to modify names, attributes, and list memberships.

title: CVE-2026-137576 — Iceburg CRM through 5
summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust disk space by uploading files to the POST /data/import route. Attackers without import permission can repeatedly upload input_file payloads that are stored in storage/app/temp and parsed before permission checks, never deleted, causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137577 — Iceburg CRM through 5
summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify any user record by supplying arbitrary record_id values to POST /data/save. Attackers can submit a save request for the ice_users module with the administrator's record_id to change their password or email and take over the account.

title: CVE-2026-137578 — FacturaONE para WooCommerce con VeriFactu before 5
summary: FacturaONE para WooCommerce con VeriFactu before 5.61 contains an authenticated SQL injection vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject SQL through the fone_client_id user meta value. title: CVE-2026-137583 — Juspay Hyperswitch 1
summary: Juspay Hyperswitch 1.8.0 before 1.129.0 uses a hardcoded default webhook secret that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge Stripe webhooks when no merchant webhook secret is configured. Attackers knowing a merchant ID and connector transaction ID can sign a crafted payment_intent.succeeded event with "default_secret" to mark uncaptured payments as succeeded.

title: CVE-2026-137584 — Twenty through 2

Attackers can submit the leaked personalInviteToken to signUpInWorkspace to join the workspace with the invitation's role, including Admin, and obtain a verified email.

title: CVE-2026-137585 — Bazarr 1

Attackers can append percent-encoded '..' segments after the 'workbox-' prefix to read files like config.yaml containing stored API keys and credentials.

title: CVE-2026-137586 — LibreChat 0
summary: LibreChat 0.7.3 before 0.8.9 contains an improper input type validation vulnerability in the requireLdapAuth middleware of the /api/auth/login route that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a JSON login request with an existing directory user's email and a non-string password, triggering an ldapjs assertion error that terminates the Node.js process.

title: CVE-2026-137587 — LIVE555 Streaming Media before 2026

A malicious RTSP server or crafted SDP Vorbis or Theora configuration can crash clients or leak heap memory through proxied SDP configurations.

title: CVE-2026-137594 — MISP contains an authorization flaw in the SharingGroup model's checkIfAuthorisedExtend method
summary:
MISP contains an authorization flaw in the SharingGroup model's checkIfAuthorisedExtend method. The method grants sync users (those with the perm_sync role) an exemption from the extend flag requirement when modifying sharing group membership. However, this exemption was applied unconditionally to all sharing groups, including those created locally on the instance (local = 1). The intended behavior, consistent with the sync push path, is that the exemption should only apply to sharing groups received through sync from another instance (local = 0).

title: CVE-2026-71409 — GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher
summary:
GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher.c. Due to the use of an unchecked sprintf() call when appending the STY environment variable to the global SocketPath buffer. The vulnerability occurs when GNU screen is executed in an environment where the HOME and STY environment variables contain attacker-controlled values that are sufficiently long. Successful exploitation may result in an application crash or potentially arbitrary code execution.


This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

title: CVE-2026-71410 — GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8_handle_comb() function in encoding
summary:
GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8_handle_comb() function in encoding.c. Due to improper error handling during memory allocation failure, the global combchars pointer is freed but not reset to NULL. When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. An attacker who controls terminal content sent to the screen session, such as via a rogue SSH server or crafted escape sequences, can exploit this vulnerability to perform heap grooming and achieve arbitrary code execution.



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.

title: CVE-2026-71411 — GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in the hardcopy file handler
summary:
GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in the hardcopy file handler. Due to checking write permissions using the real user ID and subsequently opening the file using the effective user ID, a local unprivileged attacker can atomically replace the target path with a symbolic link pointing to an arbitrary system file. Successfully exploiting this race condition allows the attacker to write to arbitrary files with root privileges, leading to local privilege escalation



This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

summary: A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Syllabus-Aligned Learning Management & Examination System 1.0.
