title: CVE-2026-73517 — KubeSphere 4
summary: KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permi

title: CVE-2026-110470 — Stack-based buffer overflow in the mkevent helper in Checkmk <2
summary: Stack-based buffer overflow in the mkevent helper in Checkmk <2.5.0p21, <2.4.0p42 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows an attacker who controls the check output of a monitored host to crash mkevent, causing the notification to be lost, or to redirect the notification to an IPv4 address of their choice, if notifications are forwarded to the Event Console.

title: CVE-2026-123265 — Rejected reason: this CVE was issued in error
summary: Rejected reason: this CVE was issued in error.

title: CVE-2026-135135 — Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations
summary: Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations. As a result, values that the application declared as encrypted may be written to the database in cleartext, with no error or warning returned to the application. A party holding only basic read privileges on the affected collection, and no access to the encryption keys, may then obtain those values in readable form.

title: CVE-2026-135138 — Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller
summary: Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller. In an application that forwards caller-supplied attribute names into a document update, a user with basic application privileges may change values held inside a field the model declared immutable. This may result in unintended modification of data the application treats as trusted, such as flags used for its own access decisions.

title: CVE-2026-135139 — Mongoid contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the handling of caller-supplied filters for bulk removal through a referenced association
summary: Mongoid contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the handling of caller-supplied filters for bulk removal through a referenced association. Conditions already attached to the association can take precedence over the filter the caller supplied, so records the caller did not select may be removed. A user with basic privileges in an application built on the library may cause unintended removal of records belonging to the same parent record.

title: CVE-2026-135140 — Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to an
summary: Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to another record. The value is then stored in readable form instead of encrypted, and the application receives no indication that this has happened. A party with ordinary authenticated read access to the affected collection may be able to view data that was intended to be protected.

title: CVE-2026-135141 — A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no rec
summary: A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no records to be silently discarded when it is combined into a query. A user with basic application privileges who sends an ordinary request may read, change, or remove records that the restriction was intended to withhold.

title: CVE-2026-135146 — An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that
summary: An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.

title: CVE-2026-135225 — An information exposure weakness in the connection string handling of the MongoDB Ruby Driver can place credential material from the application's own
summary: An information exposure weakness in the connection string handling of the MongoDB Ruby Driver can place credential material from the application's own configuration into the text of a parsing error, where an existing redaction control does not apply. A party able to read the application's error output or logs may thereby obtain database credential text together with deployment coordinates. The condition arises entirely within the embedding application process and requires no database authentication.

title: CVE-2026-135226 — A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serial
summary: A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.

title: CVE-2026-135227 — An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured in
summary: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.

title: CVE-2026-135898 — An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted B
summary: An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.

title: CVE-2026-136697 — A flaw has been found in LibrePhotos up to 1
summary: A flaw has been found in LibrePhotos up to 1.2.1. Affected by this issue is the function write_metadata of the file apps/backend/api/metadata/writer.py of the component ExifTool Metadata Write-Back. This manipulation of the argument person_name causes argument injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.0 can resolve this issue. Patch name: f83dafca9f1a6dd0441b7e4d5c13992896a7d76f. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-136721 — A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4
summary: A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4.5.3. This affects the function _print_table of the file pwiz.py of the component File Import Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The reported GitHub issue was closed with the reason "completed". However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

title: CVE-2026-136722 — A vulnerability was identified in Zhengzhou Weiwei Information Technology mayicms up to 5
summary: A vulnerability was identified in Zhengzhou Weiwei Information Technology mayicms up to 5.8E. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file member.php. Such manipulation of the argument code leads to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: CVE-2026-81405 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

title: CVE-2026-81406 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

title: CVE-2026-81407 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis.

title: CVE-2026-81408 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while processing a malicious DRDA response. A malicious DRDA service on a scanned host can make the loop consume memory without bound on 64-bit builds, exhausting the Nmap process and discarding NSE results for every other host in the same scan batch without reporting an error; the library is reached by service probes during version detection (-sV).

title: CVE-2026-81409 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A)

title: CVE-2026-81410 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including internal and loopback addresses, making Nmap send a GET request there; response content is not returned to the attacker.

title: CVE-2026-81411 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

title: CVE-2026-81412 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

title: CVE-2026-81413 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

title: CVE-2026-81414 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

title: CVE-2026-81415 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

title: CVE-2026-81416 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

title: CVE-2026-81417 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set.

title: CVE-2026-81418 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

title: CVE-2026-81419 — Nmap before 7
summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.

title: CVE-2026-107633 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.11 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to self-approve their own merge request and merge code into protected branches due to incorrect authorization when a security policy prohibited author self-approval.

title: CVE-2026-119452 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to obtain another user's authenticated session cookie and gain unauthorized access to that user's account due to improper session storage handling in the dependency proxy authentication flow when a redirect-pending state was triggered.

title: CVE-2026-129982 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with a fine-grained personal access token to read and apply merge request suggestions from projects outside the token's scope due to incorrect authorization checks.

title: CVE-2026-131867 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that on instances with incoming email enabled could have allowed an authenticated user with CI job access to obtain sensitive information belonging to another user due to improper scope validation.

title: CVE-2026-132156 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing server-side input validation on on-call rotation values.

title: CVE-2026-132822 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.7 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing resource limits in the error tracking integration.

title: CVE-2026-133463 — SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs
summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

title: CVE-2026-133464 — SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs
summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, FileStore.ValidatePassword in the SFTP server does not reject zero-length secrets before comparing them, causing an empty login password to match any account configured without one, such as public-key-only or certificate-only users. Because password authentication is enabled by default, a remote attacker who knows a valid username can log in without a key or secret and obtain an SFTP session with that user's home directory and path permissions. This issue is fixed in version 4.46.

title: CVE-2026-133465 — Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool
summary: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument boundaries without escaping. A monitored stat value, such as a mount point name, that is quoted in an action command template can contain a quote character that breaks out of its quote boundary and injects additional arguments into the process the action invokes. No shell operator is needed for this attack. This issue has been fixed in version 4.5.7.

title: CVE-2026-135221 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.10 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to perform server-side request forgery against internal network resources due to insufficient URL validation in MCP server OAuth handling.

title: CVE-2026-135486 — Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data
summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of fi

title: CVE-2026-135487 — Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile
summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.

title: CVE-2026-135636 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to send requests to internal network resources due to insufficient validation in repository import.

title: CVE-2026-136723 — A security flaw has been discovered in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4
summary: A security flaw has been discovered in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.6. This issue affects the function saveData of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component User Management. Performing a manipulation of the argument roles results in missing authorization. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 4.7.7 is capable of addressing this issue. The patch is named 762a32a374f68cd2cbad12c0d710dcd537f3b127. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-136724 — A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4
summary: A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded.

title: CVE-2026-136725 — A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4
summary: A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. Affected by this issue is the function fillModelFromData of the file src/Services/AdminService.php. The manipulation of the argument id/remember_token/enabled leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 can resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 9b0c98dc3e2710b2ba8d7579da89ec6a4042fcc8. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

title: CVE-2026-16744 — GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17
summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that on instances with receptive cluster agents enabled could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to make requests to internal network services through the GitLab agent server due to insufficient validation of destination addresses.

title: CVE-2026-77230 — Camunda 8
summary: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combi

title: CVE-2026-99808 — In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option L2CAP_OPTIONS accept
summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option

L2CAP_OPTIONS accepts a txwin_size of zero and
stores it in tx_win. The zero is then sent to the
peer in our configuration request, and if the
channel ends up in ERTM mode it is passed to
l2cap_seq_list_init().

Use the default TxWindow instead, as the mode can
still be changed to ERTM during configuration.

title: CVE-2026-132265 — AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents
summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, sandbox file extraction has no cumulative byte or file-count limit. A user who can run a code-execution block that extracts files can exhaust the memory of the shared workflow executor, interrupting other users' runs on it. Each file was allowed up to 50 MB based on a size that the sandbox itself reported. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

title: CVE-2026-133466 — OpenEXR is the reference implementation and specification for the EXR image format, widely used in the motion picture industry
summary: OpenEXR is the reference implementation and specification for the EXR image format, widely used in the motion picture industry. From versions 3.4.0 through 3.4.18 and 3.5.0 through 3.5.2, decoding a crafted HT-compressed EXR chunk can cause ht_undo_impl() to write a 4-byte pixel value through a pointer that is not 4-byte aligned. This happens when the channels sum to a bytes-per-scanline stride that is not a multiple of four. This issue is fixed in versions 3.4.19 and 3.5.3.

title: CVE-2026-133467 — CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module
summary: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.5.

title: CVE-2026-134070 — Improper input validation in the AWS-managed AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook AWSConfigRemediation-EnableSystemsManagerSessionManagerAuditLogsTo
summary: Improper input validation in the AWS-managed AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook AWSConfigRemediation-EnableSystemsManagerSessionManagerAuditLogsToS3 might allow an authenticated remote user who is permitted to run the runbook to set unintended configuration in the account's Regional Session Manager preferences document (SSM-SessionManagerRunShell) via a crafted S3KeyPrefix parameter value. This applies only when that document does not already exist in the Region. The unintended configuration can include arbitrary commands, which then run on managed instances when other users start Session

title: CVE-2026-136727 — A security flaw has been discovered in caoqianming django-vue-admin up to 849f9aafa552380c64eecc6059e357f6a1f5437a
summary: A security flaw has been discovered in caoqianming django-vue-admin up to 849f9aafa552380c64eecc6059e357f6a1f5437a. This affects the function UserModifySerializer of the file server/apps/system/serializers.py. The manipulation results in dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The patch is identified as d0bc4cf6232798d1f977eb4cad03738a968c4869. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

title: CVE-2026-136733 — A weakness has been identified in EduardoPires EquinoxProject up to 1
summary: A weakness has been identified in EduardoPires EquinoxProject up to 1.10. This vulnerability affects the function BuildToken of the file src/Equinox.Services.Api/appsettings.Development.json of the component JWT Bearer Authentication. This manipulation of the argument SecretKey with the input fmFGn5agHZkuG2N0e1zaEJIQtGVoNN5P causes hard-coded credentials. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

title: CVE-2026-137056 — DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2
summary: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privileges, exposing stored provider API keys and session history.

title: CVE-2026-137057 — llama
summary: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the process and exhaust memory.

title: CVE-2026-137058 — Cron-parser through 5
summary: Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

title: CVE-2026-137059 — ToolJet from 3
summary: ToolJet from 3.16.0 before 3.20.256 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in StripeWebhookGuard that validates webhooks against a self-generated signature instead of the Stripe-Signature header. Unauthenticated attackers can post forged Stripe events to the POST /api/organization/payment/webhooks route to activate subscriptions, generate licenses, change plans or seats, and add AI credits without payment.

title: CVE-2026-137060 — paramz through 0
summary: paramz through 0.10.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted model files to paramz.load(), which calls pickle.load() without restrictions. Attackers can embed objects whose __reduce__ method returns callables like exec or os.system in shared paramz or GPy model files to run code with the victim's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-137061 — Wallos before 5
summary: Wallos before 5.11.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability that allows authenticated users or API key holders to exhaust server resources by storing subscriptions with a frequency of 0. Attackers can trigger renew.php or get_monthly_cost.php to loop forever on a P0D interval, pinning PHP workers and hanging the next-payment cron job for all users.

title: CVE-2026-137062 — BookStack before 26
summary: BookStack before 26.09.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editors to permanently delete recycle bin content by converting chapters to books or books to shelves. Attackers can trigger TrashCan::destroyEntity() through the conversion actions to force-delete soft-deleted children, revisions and attachments, including content deleted by other users, preventing restoration.

title: CVE-2026-137063 — Leptonica 1
summary: Leptonica 1.79.0 through 1.87.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in l_byteaInitFromStream() that allows attackers to write past a heap buffer by supplying oversized input. Attackers can provide a file larger than 1,000,000,000 bytes, causing l_byteaCreate() to allocate a 201-byte buffer before memcpy copies the full stream size, crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-137064 — Chatwoot before 4
summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Bandwidth SMS webhook endpoint POST /webhooks/sms/:phone_number that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit forged SMS events. Attackers who know an inbox phone number can set the 'to' field to inject inbound messages with forged sender numbers or forge delivery status updates.

title: CVE-2026-137065 — Chatwoot before 4
summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows account administrators to attach integration hooks to other accounts' inboxes by supplying a foreign inbox_id. Attackers can create a Dialogflow hook referencing a victim inbox, leaving its new conversations stuck as pending awaiting a bot, and enumerate inbox IDs to disclose inbox names.

title: CVE-2026-137066 — Loginizer before 2
summary: Loginizer before 2.1.4 contains a brute-force lockout bypass vulnerability in loginizer_login_failed() that allows unauthenticated attackers to avoid failed-attempt recording via non-ASCII URL bytes. Attackers can append invalid UTF-8 or 4-byte sequences to wp-login.php or xmlrpc.php request URLs, causing the log INSERT to fail and enabling unlimited password guessing without lockout or email notification.

title: CVE-2026-137067 — GNOME libxml2 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmlValidatePopElement because xmlCtxtReset frees the DTD without popping stale validation states. Attackers supplying an XML document ending inside an element to an application reusing a DTD-validating xmlTextReader can trigger heap reads, causing crashes and limited heap disclosure via error messages.

title: CVE-2026-137068 — libxml2 through 2
summary: libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering xmlFreeNode on a stale reader->faketext node after xmlTextReader reuse. Attackers can supply XML containing a namespace declaration to applications that read its value and reuse the reader, causing a freed document's dictionary read and process crash.

title: CVE-2026-137069 — libxml2 2
summary: libxml2 2.13.0 through 2.15.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability because xmlTextReaderSetup does not reset reader->state when a reader is reused. Attackers can submit one malformed XML document to an application reusing a single reader, causing every later document to be rejected until the reader is recreated.

title: CVE-2026-137070 — GEOS 3
summary: GEOS 3.13.0 before 3.15.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in RectangleContains::isContainedInBoundary that recurses indefinitely on curved geometries returned by getGeometryN. Attackers can supply crafted WKT or WKB CircularString, CompoundCurve, or CurvePolygon geometries tested via PreparedGeometry::contains or GEOSPreparedContains against a prepared rectangle to crash the process with a stack overflow.

title: CVE-2026-137071 — Boost
summary: Boost.JSON 1.84.0 through 1.92.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability because parser_for reset() does not reset nested parse_into handlers, retaining state across documents. Attackers controlling an abandoned or subsequent document parsed by a reused parser_for can cause partial string data from one document to appear in another's result.

title: CVE-2026-137072 — GNOME libxml2 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger stale DTD validation states after xmlTextReaderCurrentDoc documents are freed. Attackers can supply an XML document ending with an error inside an element, causing xmlTextReaderClose to read freed element declarations, leading to crashes and possible invalid frees.

title: CVE-2026-137073 — GNOME libxml2 through 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a double free vulnerability in xmlReaderNewWalker() that frees reader->input again after xmlTextReaderClose() already released it. Applications reusing a closed xmlTextReader with xmlReaderNewWalker() can crash, and groomed heap memory can control the close callback for possible code execution.

title: CVE-2026-137074 — GNOME libxml2 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 2.12.6 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlTextReaderConstEncoding() after a reader is reset with xmlReaderNewWalker(). Because xmlCtxtReset() leaves ctxt->input NULL, querying the document encoding makes xmlGetActualEncoding() read ctxt->input->flags without a check, crashing the application and causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137075 — GNOME libxml2 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 2.14.0 through 2.15.4 contains a missing NUL termination flaw in xmlBufferAddHead() in buf.c that leaves uninitialized heap bytes as the terminator for storage-less buffers. Attackers supplying data to applications reusing an xmlBuffer can trigger over-reads via xmlBufferCat() and xmlStrlen(), disclosing adjacent heap memory or causing crashes.

title: CVE-2026-137076 — FFmpeg through 9
summary: FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because avcodec_flush_buffers() does not release the decoder context's frame buffer pool, so recycled buffers retain prior picture data. Attackers can supply crafted damaged streams to applications reusing one decoder context across users to recover another user's decoded picture content from unwritten frame regions.

title: CVE-2026-137077 — FreeRDP before 3
summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds write in h264_context_reset() in libfreerdp/codec/h264.c, which stores new dimensions before the YUV planes are reallocated. Remote peers can trigger surface height increases so avc420_compress() writes taller frames past undersized luma and chroma planes, corrupting heap memory or crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-137078 — Xiph
summary: Xiph.Org libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ov_time_tell() in lib/vorbisfile.c that reads vf->vi[-1].rate after a failed seek leaves vf->pcm_offset at -1. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg Vorbis file with a corrupted page to applications that seek and query playback time, leaking heap bytes via the returned value or crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-137079 — libvorbis through 1
summary: libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in _ov_getlap() in lib/vorbisfile.c that passes a negative sample count from vorbis_synthesis_lapout() to memcpy(). Attackers can supply a short, valid Ogg Vorbis file with suitable block sizes to overwrite stack frames and crash applications performing two consecutive lapped seeks.

title: CVE-2026-137080 — libical 4
summary: libical 4.0.0 before 4.0.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icalrecur_iterator_set_range() that allows attackers to cause denial of service by supplying crafted recurrence rules. Attackers can provide a calendar whose recurrence rule is iterated over a reverse range, causing the loop to never terminate and spin the calling thread at full CPU indefinitely.

title: CVE-2026-137081 — Xiph
summary: Xiph.Org libFLAC 1.5.0 contains a memory leak in FLAC__stream_encoder_finish() because free_() never releases the main thread task's frame bit writer buffer. Attackers submitting many audio streams to a long-running service that reuses one encoder can leak at least 32 KiB per stream, causing memory exhaustion.

title: CVE-2026-137082 — GNOME libxml2 through 2
summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlParseStartTag2() that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering parser context reuse after SAX1 parsing. Attackers can supply documents with attributes parsed first with XML_PARSE_SAX1 and then without it on a reused context, causing writes to unallocated ctxt->attallocs and denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137083 — OpenCV 3
summary: OpenCV 3.0.0 through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the built-in MJPEG encoder when writing grayscale frames due to incorrect level shifting in convertToYUV(). Attackers controlling pixel content written as grayscale MJPEG video can trigger unchecked cat_table and huff_dc_tab lookups, leaking adjacent or uninitialized memory into the output file or crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-137084 — NodeBB 4
summary: NodeBB 4.12.0 before 4.16.4 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability in the Intents.create controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger ActivityPub note ingestion. Attackers can send GET requests to /intents/create with a remote note URI in the toPid parameter to inject federated content as local topics and posts.

title: CVE-2026-137085 — ProjeQtOr before 13
summary: ProjeQtOr before 13.1.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in tool/getAFieldForAClassById.php that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read any object property. Attackers can request Class=User with an administrator id and field=password or email to retrieve password hashes for offline cracking.

title: CVE-2026-137086 — Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4
summary: Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4.07 contains a predictable session cookie vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions by guessing tick-counter-derived cookies. Attackers can predict or brute-force the 32-bit cookie from device uptime and login timing to control relays, settings, and administrator credentials.

title: CVE-2026-137087 — @irrelon/path 6
summary: @irrelon/path 6.2.2 before 7.0.3 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in merge() and mergeImmutable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass untrusted JSON containing __proto__ or constructor.prototype payloads to merged objects, causing property injection, authorization bypass, or denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137088 — @oleksii-pavlov/deep-merge before 1
summary: @oleksii-pavlov/deep-merge before 1.2.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in deepMergeTwoAssignable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying a __proto__ key. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input to deepMerge(), deepMergeAndAssign(), deepUpdate() or deepUpdateAndAssign() to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-137089 — merge-deep-composed through 0
summary: merge-deep-composed through 0.1.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in _mergeDeepOne() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input containing __proto__ as a merge source to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service in Node.js processes.

title: CVE-2026-137090 — build-git-clone before 1
summary: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

title: CVE-2026-137091 — EverOS before 1
summary: EverOS before 1.8.0 contains a cross-origin local file disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious websites to read local files by abusing a wildcard CORS policy with credentials and unrestricted file:// ingestion. Attackers can host JavaScript that calls POST /api/v2/memory/add with file:// URIs, then read parsed contents via POST /api/v2/memory/search to exfiltrate SSH keys, credentials, and alter or delete memories.

title: CVE-2026-137092 — Assimp before 6
summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::MakeDataUnique() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying unvalidated face indices. Attackers can craft an .md5mesh file with out-of-range face vertex indices or unfilled faces to set bits past the abHad allocation, read vertex data out of bounds, or crash the application.

title: CVE-2026-137093 — Assimp before 6
summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::LoadMD5MeshFile() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via unvalidated weight ranges and bone indices. Attackers can supply a crafted .md5mesh file with out-of-range mBone values to increment heap words past the piCount allocation, causing memory corruption, out-of-bounds reads, or crashes.

title: CVE-2026-102957 — z_impl_pwm_capture_cycles() in drivers/pwm/pwm_capture
summary:
z_impl_pwm_capture_cycles() in drivers/pwm/pwm_capture.c stores its capture context (struct z_pwm_capture_cb_data, including a struct k_sem) on its own stack and registers a pointer to it as the driver capture callback's user_data. When called with a K_NO_WAIT timeout, k_sem_take() returns -EBUSY, which the function did not handle: it fell through, returned the uninitialized status field, copied uninitialized period/pulse values to the caller when that status happened to be zero, and returned without disabling the capture or clearing the callback.

summary:

summary:

It never checks that length against the destination buffer. title: CVE-2018-25445 — Crypt::JWT versions before 0
summary:
Crypt::JWT versions before 0.024 for Perl skip issuer, subject, audience and JWT ID checks when the claim is absent or the option is a plain string.

decode_jwt runs the verify_iss, verify_sub, verify_aud and verify_jti checks only when the token carries the claim, and honours an option only as a Regexp or CODE reference. Any other value, such as verify_aud => 'myapp', is ignored.

An application that relies on these checks accepts a validly signed token meant for a different issuer, subject or audience.

title: CVE-2022-50995 — WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0
summary:
WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.27 for Perl read one byte before the input buffer when parsing an empty string.

parse_urlencoded and parse_urlencoded_arrayref check for a trailing "&" or ";" by reading the last byte of the input, without first checking that the input has any bytes.

A remote client that sends an empty query string or request body to an application parsing it with this module can crash the process.

title: CVE-2022-50996 — WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0
summary:
WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.28 for Perl write past the end of the Perl argument stack when parse_urlencoded returns many pairs.

parse_urlencoded returns its result as a list, pushing each decoded key and value onto the argument stack without first extending the stack to fit them. parse_urlencoded_arrayref returns an array reference and is not affected.

A remote client that sends a query string or request body with many pairs to an application parsing it with parse_urlencoded can corrupt memory and crash the process.

title: CVE-2026-135092 — PDF::API2 versions before 2
summary:
PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr.

When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table and calls itself on the offset in the trailer's /Prev entry. Nothing records which offsets it has already read, so a /Prev entry pointing back to an earlier table, or to its own, makes it recurse without end.

An attacker who supplies a crafted PDF can cause a denial of service in any application that opens it.

title: CVE-2026-136511 — psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or
summary:
psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or SSLmode={verify-full}, to disable. SQLDriverConnect() then returned SQL_SUCCESS with no diagnostic, and the connection was not encrypted.

An attacker on the network path of such a connection can read and change its traffic.

Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

title: CVE-2026-136512 — With SQL_C_DEFAULT, the C type of a bound column or parameter follows its SQL type
summary:

When the column had another type at fetch time, because the server reported another type, the table was altered, or an output parameter's result column had another type, psqlODBC wrote the larger type into the smaller buffer: 12 bytes past a 4-byte buffer for a uuid, and more in multi-row fetches, where the driver also steps through the array by the larger size.

title: CVE-2026-136513 — When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory
summary:
When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded ~, which is resolved relative to the process's current directory. Another local user who controls a directory on that path can make the driver create the victim's mylog_*.log and psqlodbc_*.log files in any directory the victim can write to, or leave the victim's process blocked in open().

This completes the fix for CVE-2026-120066 in 18.00.0006.

Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

summary:

title: CVE-2026-136795 — Crypt::JWT versions before 0
summary:
Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unbounded inflation of zip DEF payloads.

When a token header sets "zip" to "DEF", decode_jwt inflates the payload with no limit on the output size. A signed token is inflated after its signature verifies. An encrypted token is inflated after decryption, and with RSA-OAEP or ECDH-ES key management anyone who holds the recipient's public key can produce a token that decrypts.

title: CVE-2026-136796 — Crypt::JWT versions before 0
summary:
Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via an unbounded PBES2 iteration count.

For a token using a PBES2 key management algorithm, decode_jwt passes the p2c header parameter to PBKDF2 as the iteration count without a range check, and derives the key before any integrity check. Unless accepted_alg rules it out, a token can select PBES2 whenever decode_jwt is given a symmetric key.

title: CVE-2026-8748 — Crypt::JWT versions before 0
summary:
Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl compare HMAC signatures and JWE authentication tags in non-constant time.

decode_jwt compares HS256, HS384 and HS512 signatures, and the authentication tag of A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384 and A256CBC-HS512 encrypted tokens, against the computed value with Perl's eq operator. Its run time depends on the number of matching leading bytes.

An attacker who can submit many candidate tokens and measure the timing precisely enough may recover the expected signature or tag byte by byte and forge a token that verifies.

title: CVE-2026-134283 — Webmin through 2

title_vi: CVE-2026-134283 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134304 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in apache/restart.cgi that displays the last five Apache ErrorLog lines without HTML escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can inject script into error_log via malformed requests or denied paths, executing in a Webmin user's session when Apache fails to restart.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134304 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134305 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/raw.cgi that allows attackers with LDAP attribute write access to inject markup. Attackers can store script in user or group attributes or the dn, which executes in an administrator's browser when viewing the raw entry.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134305 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134323 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in generic_ldap_connect in ldap-client-lib.pl that accepts any LDAPS or StartTLS server certificate. Man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate the LDAP server to capture the bind DN password, often the root DN, and return forged directory data.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134323 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134326 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134326 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134328 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mailboxes/detach.cgi that allows unauthenticated mail senders to bypass the HTML sanitizer. Attackers can send HTML attachments with entity-obfuscated javascript: schemes or encoded script tags in iframe srcdoc to execute script in the Webmin session of users opening them.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134328 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134333 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/view_table.cgi that allows MySQL users to inject scripts via unescaped column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privilege can create columns containing HTML payloads that execute in a Webmin administrator's session when the table is viewed.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134333 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134336 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts by submitting malicious failed-login usernames. Attackers can repeatedly submit crafted usernames until blocked, executing script in administrator sessions viewing edit_blocked.cgi in Webmin or Usermin.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134336 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134340 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Servers Index module that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to inject scripts via the realhost field of UDP discovery replies. Attackers on the same broadcast domain can answer discovery scans with HTML or JavaScript stored by find_servers() and rendered unescaped by edit_serv.cgi, executing in Webmin user sessions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134340 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134365 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows on-path network attackers to inject script by tampering with plaintext HTTP search results rendered unescaped. Attackers who intercept rpmfind.net or Google responses can inject autofocus/onfocus payloads that execute in a logged-in user's browser within the Webmin origin.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134365 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134368 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in lpadmin/list_jobs.cgi that allows local users or network IPP clients to inject script via CUPS print-job titles. Attackers can submit a print job with a crafted title, for example using lp -t, to execute script in a Printer Administration user's Webmin session.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134368 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134437 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-server/edit_browser.cgi that allows attackers with write access to LDAP entry attributes to inject script by storing markup in attribute values. When an administrator browses the entry in the LDAP Server directory browser, the unencoded script runs in the Webmin origin, letting attackers act with the administrator's session.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134437 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134438 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure download vulnerability in webmin/upgrade.cgi, cluster-webmin/upgrade.cgi and cluster-usermin/upgrade.cgi that fetches upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP with GnuPG signature verification disabled by default. On-path network attackers can substitute a malicious RPM, Debian or tar.gz package during a default upgrade to execute code as root on the Webmin host and managed cluster servers.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134438 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134439 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying values from managed hosts that cluster modules render unescaped. Attackers who can edit a Servers Index description, control a managed host, or intercept its RPC link can inject server descriptions, versions, user/group names, or package fields to execute JavaScript in the central administrator's session.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134439 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134440 — Webmin through 2
summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a Perl code injection vulnerability in cluster-useradmin/sync.cgi that allows attackers to run code by placing single quotes in home directory paths. Attackers with root on one managed host can craft a home path that breaks out of remote_eval() string literals during Sync, executing Perl as root on other managed hosts.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134440 — Webmin đến 2

title: CVE-2026-134441 — Webmin through 2

CVE-2026-133745 — The router redirects a request to the same URL with or without its trailing slash, or with the scheme that a route requires
summary:
The router redirects a request to the same URL with or without its trailing slash, or with the scheme that a route requires. To do so, the matcher returns RedirectController::urlRedirectAction() with the path info of the request as path. Since Symfony 5.4.44, 6.4.12 and 7.1.5, urlRedirectAction() turns a path that starts with // into <scheme>://..., so that protocol-relative targets configured in routes work. The path info of a request starts with // when its URI does. So these redirects send the browser to the host written at the start of the path:

GET https://app.example//evil.example/edit/

summary:

That check doesn't run when framework.router.strict_requirements is null, which the routing recipe sets in the prod environment. There, a first placeholder whose value starts with / still gives a protocol-relative URL, as in the original report:

title: CVE-2026-133747 — Since Symfony 7
summary:
Since Symfony 7.4, framework.http_client.scoped_clients can enable caching on a scoped client. FrameworkBundle then puts a CachingHttpClient inside the ScopingHttpClient, with the options of the scope as default options. CachingHttpClient merges them into every request. So the credentials of the scope, like auth_bearer, auth_basic or an Authorization header, are also sent to URLs outside the scope:

framework:
    http_client:
        scoped_clients:
            github.client:
                base_uri: 'https://api.github.com'
                headers: { Authorization: 'token GH-SECRET' }

title: CVE-2026-133748 — NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient accepts a list of subnets to block instead of its default one
summary:

title: 'God Mode' Flaws Could Wreak Border-Control Havoc
summary: Attackers could have disrupted traveler entry into Nigeria, Ethiopia, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Fiji, and Ghana via several vulnerabilities in their online visa and immigration systems.

title: Second Norwegian Energy Company Breached in 2 Days
summary: No specific link has been drawn between the two incidents, though they certainly sing the same notes.

title: Critical PHP Flaws Allow Code Execution, but Don't Panic 'PHP2Shell'-Style
summary: November's monthly security release patches seven critical PHP flaws that should be addressed ASAP, though experts say exploitability varies and depends heavily on configuration.

title: Navigating Vulnerability Hysteria in the AI Era
summary: This installment of the Reporters' Notebook video series examines the fallout from recent high-severity flaw disclosures, exploring how fears of AI-assisted exploits trigger widespread panic, operational disruptions, and growing warning fatigue.

title: Why Holiday Security Can't Wait for Black Friday
summary: Bot-driven fraud and holiday social engineering attacks stretch across many weeks, straining security teams and small businesses alike.

title: Colorado says cyberattack took down myColorado app, warns 150,000 had data stolen
summary: Cybercriminals likely stole data from 150,000 users of myColorado, which residents typically use for digital identification, document storage and accessing state government services.

title: California privacy agency director Kemp to leave after two-year tenure
summary: The director of the trailblazing California Privacy Protection Agency announced his departure following implementation of a first-in-the-nation platform allowing consumers to easily opt out of data sharing.

title: CVE-2026-61512 — VeraCrypt before 1
summary: VeraCrypt before 1.26.30 on Linux contains a command injection vulnerability in CoreUnix::CheckFilesystem that allows a local attacker with same-UID access and an active elevated CoreService session to execute arbitrary commands by injecting an unsanitized VirtualDevice value into a shell command string. Attackers can reopen the request pipe through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> and supply a crafted VirtualDevice value such as /dev/null; <command> to achieve arbitrary command execution as root.
title_vi: CVE-2026-61512 — VeraCrypt trước 1

title: CVE-2026-61513 — VeraCrypt through 1
summary: VeraCrypt through 1.26.31 on Linux contains an improper path restriction vulnerability in the elevated CoreService, which passes the path and owner UID from a SetFileOwnerRequest directly to chown() in CoreUnix::SetFileOwner without target validation on Linux. An attacker with an active elevated CoreService session and same-UID access who reopens the request pipe through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n> can take ownership of arbitrary system files such as /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow, achieving full root compromise.
title_vi: CVE-2026-61513 — VeraCrypt đến 1

Summary

MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation paths using assert(). In a standard release/production build (NDEBUG defined) assert() expands to a no-op, so an invariant the code intends to halt on instead falls through, and execution continues with the bad or inconsistent state. Where the guarded condition is attacker-influenceable through the flash-write boundary (serial-recovery / DFU), this is a security check that is simply absent in release builds.

title: CVE-2026-122093 — Strong::Random versions through 0
summary:

title: CVE-2026-135768 — A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows
summary: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.

summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases.

title: CVE-2026-136451 — A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator
summary: A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator. Deterministic hashes derived from Kubernetes Secrets are published in generated StatefulSet metadata and in KeycloakOIDCClient status. A user with read access to those resources may be able to recover a low-entropy credential referenced by a Secret, even when Kubernetes RBAC denies the user access to the Secret itself.

title: CVE-2026-136615 — league/commonmark 2
summary: league/commonmark 2.6.0 before 2.10.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in DelimiterStack::push() that miscounts delimiter runs against the max_delimiters_per_line budget. Attackers submitting Markdown with two long emphasis character runs can produce deeply nested strong elements, causing quadratic rendering time and CPU exhaustion.

title: CVE-2026-136616 — COVESA Open1722 before 0
summary: COVESA Open1722 before 0.9.8 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Avtp_Vss_CalcVssPathLength in src/avtp/acf/custom/Vss.c, which reads the INTEROP path-length prefix without checking the declared ACF message length. Attackers can send header-only 12-byte INTEROP-mode VSS frames to trigger reads past the buffer, or prefix values 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF that wrap uint16 lengths and cause Avtp_Vss_SetVssData to overwrite the path area.

title: CVE-2026-136617 — Shopify async-memcached before 0
summary: Shopify async-memcached before 0.11.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in Client::validate_meta_flags that allows attackers to inject extra memcached meta protocol tokens via whitespace in flags. Attackers controlling part of a meta flag can add quiet, opaque, mode or size override tokens to alter operations and desynchronize responses on shared connections.

title: CVE-2026-136618 — Karakeep before 0
summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in ManualList.mergeInto that allows list owners to retain collaborator bookmarks by merging shared lists without ownership checks. Owners invoking the lists.merge tRPC procedure create rows not tied to collaborator membership, preserving read access to collaborator bookmarks and assets after the collaborator's access is revoked.

title: CVE-2026-136619 — Karakeep before 0
summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows shared-list collaborators to learn other users' private favourited and archived bookmark state through filter queries. Viewer or editor collaborators can call bookmarks.getBookmarks on a shared list with favourited or archived set to true, inferring owners' private flags from which bookmarks buildCommonFilters returns.

title: CVE-2026-136620 — pain001-mcp 0
summary: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

title: CVE-2026-136621 — LTplus-AG ifc-lite @ifc-lite/export before 4
summary: LTplus-AG ifc-lite @ifc-lite/export before 4.13.1 and ifc-lite-export before 27.0.0 contain a STEP record injection vulnerability in the mutation writer via unescaped typed-value type names. Attackers controlling the mutations payload can place parentheses, semicolons, and newlines in typed.type to append arbitrary entity records to exported IFC files, bypassing the class-name guard.

title: CVE-2026-136622 — WeKan before 12
summary: WeKan before 12.78 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Exporter.buildStream() that lets attackers retrieve checklists from other boards by supplying a checklistId export scope. Users able to export any board, or unauthenticated users via a public board, can read private checklists, their items and creator usernames even when anonymization is enabled.

title: CVE-2026-136623 — WeKan before 12
summary: WeKan before 12.78 contains an access control bypass in Exporter.buildCsvStream() that ignores the Disable all export and Anonymize export users settings. Board readers or unauthenticated users of public boards can request the CSV export endpoint to export all cards and reveal real usernames in member, assignee, and mention fields.

title: CVE-2026-136624 — lightNVR before 0
summary: lightNVR before 0.44.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in go2rtc_proxy_authorize_request() that allows authenticated users to access restricted cameras by exploiting inconsistent src parameter parsing. Attackers can percent-encode a second src parameter name or exceed the 255-byte truncation so go2rtc resolves a different camera, obtaining unauthorized snapshots and HLS live streams.

title: CVE-2026-136625 — ai-memory 2
summary: ai-memory 2.6.0 before 3.3.2 contains a symlink following vulnerability in the ai-memory-wikisync companion that allows local attackers to overwrite arbitrary files by planting symlinks at predictable temporary names. Attackers can place a .wikisync-tmp-<page>.md symlink in a shared destination so atomic_write() truncates and overwrites its target with the victim's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-136626 — SRS 4
summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SrsRtcpCommon::decode and SrsRtcpTWCC::decode that lets remote WebRTC peers write past the fixed 1500-byte payload_ array. Unauthenticated attackers opening a WHIP or WHEP session can send oversized BYE, APP, unknown-type or TWCC RTCP packets to overwrite up to 64 KB of heap memory, crashing the server.

title: CVE-2026-136627 — SRS 4
summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a reachable assertion in RTCP decoding that lets remote WebRTC peers crash the server. Attackers opening an unauthenticated WHIP or WHEP session can send an 8-byte RTCP packet with undersized length, triggering srs_assert aborts that stop every stream.

title: CVE-2026-136628 — Wails before 2
summary: Wails before 2.17.1 on Linux contains an origin validation error in the sendMessageToBackend WebKitGTK handler that allows child-frame scripts to invoke the privileged IPC channel. Attackers controlling content loaded in an iframe can post messages that pass the top-level URI origin check and call bound Go methods and Wails runtime operations.

title: CVE-2026-136629 — Nektos act 0
summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.95 contains an argument injection vulnerability in readProjectArgsFile and projectFlag that allows malicious repositories to bypass the untrusted project .actrc flag allowlist. Attackers can commit a crafted .actrc smuggling disallowed flags like -P self-hosted or --privileged to run workflow steps on the developer's host.

title: CVE-2026-136630 — Electerm before 5
summary: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

title: CVE-2026-136631 — Mastodon 4
summary: Mastodon 4.7.4 and 4.8.0-alpha.3 before 5.0.0-beta.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in authenticate_with_sign_in_token that allows authenticated local users to rebind pending login attempts to other accounts. Attackers can submit sign_in_token_resend with a victim's user[email] parameter, then guess the unthrottled 6-character token to sign in as inactive accounts lacking two-factor authentication.

title: CVE-2026-136632 — OpenProject 17
summary: OpenProject 17.2.0 before 17.5.2, 17.6.0 before 17.6.1, 17.7.0 before 17.7.3, 17.8.0 before 17.8.2, and 17.9.0 before 17.9.7 contains an externally controlled method selection vulnerability in InplaceEditFieldsController via the unvalidated attribute parameter. Users who can view a project can request the inplace_edit_fields reset route with attribute destroy to delete projects and subprojects, or invoke other methods exposing restricted data.

title: CVE-2026-120934 — An External Control of File Name or Path (Argument Injection) vulnerability in the settings/notification
summary:
An External Control of File Name or Path (Argument Injection) vulnerability in the settings/notification.cgi component of ADM allows authenticated remote administrators to create or truncate arbitrary files with root privileges via crafted request parameters. An authenticated administrator can truncate arbitrary critical files across the root filesystem, leading to system failure or Denial of Service (DoS).
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

summary:
An argument injection vulnerability exists in the settings/vpn.cgi endpoint in the ADM. When processing a WireGuard profile, the internal command parser removes quotes and performs a quote-agnostic scan on arguments without properly sanitizing redirection operators. An authenticated administrator can supply a crafted parameter to cause the execution helper to open and truncate arbitrary files on the filesystem with root privileges, resulting in an arbitrary file truncation and denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

title: CVE-2026-120936 — An arbitrary file creation and truncation vulnerability exists in the File Explorer of ADM
summary:
An arbitrary file creation and truncation vulnerability exists in the File Explorer of ADM. An authenticated low-privileged user can upload a file with crafted path components containing quote and redirection characters. When music.cgi processes the entry for audio playback operations, the unescaped path string breaks out of the expected argument context in the internal command parser. This causes the system execution helper to open the attacker-specified path with root privileges using O_TRUNC, allowing remote attackers to truncate or create arbitrary system files.

summary:
A stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server helper of ASUSTOR ADM allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to trigger stack memory corruption by sending a crafted DHCP hostname to a device with DHCP Server enabled. This may disrupt DHCP service.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

title: CVE-2026-120946 — An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary commands as root
summary:
An OS command injection vulnerability in ADM allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary commands as root. The set action in settings/ddns.cgi fails to sanitize configuration delimiters in user-supplied parameters before writing them into the DDNS configuration file, allowing an attacker to inject directives that execute arbitrary system commands upon service restart.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

title: CVE-2026-120947 — A potential stack-based buffer overflow exists in ADM Defender Firewall configuration handling
summary:
A potential stack-based buffer overflow exists in ADM Defender Firewall configuration handling. Before the fix, firewall policy processing used string operations without sufficient destination-size checks and did not consistently validate array bounds. Malformed or oversized configuration data may cause an out-of-bounds write and corrupt stack memory.
Affected products and versions include: from ADM 4.1.0 through ADM 4.3.3.RY62 as well as from ADM 5.0.0 through ADM 5.1.4.RM62.

title: CVE-2026-135803 — Most methods of Symfony\Component\Filesystem\Path rely on Path::split(), which takes everything before the first :// as the root of a path
summary:
Most methods of Symfony\Component\Filesystem\Path rely on Path::split(), which takes everything before the first :// as the root of a path. It doesn't check that this prefix is a URI scheme, so the .. segments in that prefix are never resolved. PHP sees a scheme only at the start of a string. So /base/../x://../secret.txt is a plain local path to /secret.txt for PHP, while Path::isBasePath('/base', '/base/../x://../secret.txt') returns true. canonicalize(), join(), makeAbsolute() and makeRelative() are affected the same way.

Some applications check a path built from user input with isBasePath

title: CVE-2026-135804 — The fix for CVE-2026-45756 lowers pcre
summary:

That limit applies to one starting position, not to one call. PCRE resets its counter at every position it tries a match from. title: CVE-2026-133770 — The sandbox allows every method of Twig\Markup objects, including their public constructor
summary:
The sandbox allows every method of Twig\Markup objects, including their public constructor. A sandboxed template can therefore call __construct() on any Markup object that it reaches, and replace its content:

{% do banner.__construct('<script>alert(1)</script>', 'UTF-8') %}

A template gains nothing by rewriting its own output. The impact is on the Markup objects that come from the application and are also rendered elsewhere, like a global in a long-running worker. Their new content then ends up in trusted pages that aren't sandboxed.

CVE-2026-133773 — The html_to_markdown filter of twig/markdown-extra keeps an HtmlConverter for each distinct mapping of options it receives
summary:
The html_to_markdown filter of twig/markdown-extra keeps an HtmlConverter for each distinct mapping of options it receives. They're kept in a static array, with no size limit and no eviction. The options are an argument of the filter. A template that passes options taken from the input, or a sandboxed template, can therefore make this cache grow without limit. The cache outlives the environment, so it fills the memory of long-running workers.

The cache now keeps at most 100 converters, like the formatter caches of IntlExtension.
